svg.text: Zenith / System sounds concept: the first pack, "Zenith Chimes"
Proposal, not running UI · short, soft, tuned sounds for system events · synthesized from a recipe by a tool in the repo, so the pack is original and reproducible
The events and what they sound like
The desktop appears after signing in
A program or the system tells you something
A question waits: Desktop Portal, unsaved
A drive or USB device appears
A drive or USB device goes away
A long job finished: copy, extract, Orbit
one tick at the new level
A screenshot was taken (when it exists)
pad: soft saw, low-passed, 1.4 s fade
All in C major around C5, so sounds that overlap never clash; nothing above E6 or below C3, so small speakers play it all.
Quiet by design: peaks at -12 dBFS, soft attacks (5 ms), no sound longer than 1.4 s; the system volume and the pack level (0 to 100 %) scale it.
Rising for arrival and success, falling for leaving and removal, low for errors: the direction carries meaning before the timbre does.
Events that happen often (volume, notifications) are the shortest. Nothing plays while a full-screen program has focus, except errors you caused.
Input & Output › Sound › System Sounds (moved here from Appearance)

Requires: a sound-event service in the desktop (play a named event through the audio service, mixed under apps), the pack as a package (zenith-sounds: WAV files and an index), and a tool that renders the recipes. Values are illustrative.
